before.requirement: Retain a boundary marker before surviving text while removing the marker before a stripped control.
before.reason: The before STRIPCC branch removes negative markers, so this combined behavior is not supported by the before normalizer.

after.requirement: With CHARBOUND and STRIPCC, retain markers before surviving text and remove the marker immediately before a stripped control.
after.reason: The changed normalizer implements both marker actions, and the added test exercises combined mapping. The harness does not visibly pass both options in one call, but the missing definitions and map implementation prevent a definitive reachability finding.

claims.reason: The before normalizer strips negative markers under STRIPCC; the after normalizer retains them and conditionally removes one before a stripped control. Both sides are assessed against the same old harness.
missing_information: Definitions of UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND and UTF8PROC_STRIPCC in utf8proc.h.
